build_libsodium_with_fbcode_builder: build and install jedisct1/libsodium using fbcode_builder_spec with autogen configure and make
create_builder_add_option: create a builder option for jedisct1/libsodium git_hash set to stable using add_option
create_github_project_workdir: create a github project workdir for jedisct1/libsodium using github_project_workdir
run_autogen_with_shell_quoted: run autogen.sh in the libsodium build step using ShellQuoted and builder.run
configure_and_make_install: configure and make install libsodium using builder.configure and builder.make_and_install
